mmq.text: The Cho-Arrim, a people who hold the River sacred, were peaceful folk fighting Mercadia City, and when the Weatherlight crash-landed on Mercadia, they attacked and stole it, since Cho-Manno took its arrival as a sign of Ramos's return.
Orim grew sympathetic to the Cho-Arrim, while Gerrard struck a deal with the Chief Magistrate to train Mercadia's army and march on the Cho-Arrim to retrieve his ship.
The Cho-Arrim repelled a cateran attack on the Rushwood, but then Mercadian soldiers led by Gerrard attacked the village and slaughtered most of its inhabitants.

In the end the Saprazzans, Cho-Arrim and Ramosians united with the Weatherlight crew to overthrow the Mercadian regime, and with the Chief Magistrate dead and the Kyren rulers exiled, the peoples formed a united government.
